blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte on Monday said she was happy that International Criminal Court (ICC) judges saw the current condition of her father, former President Rodrigo Duterte, during a recent status conference on the crimes against humanity charges against him. Sara made the statement after the former president personally appeared for the first time at the ICC Trial Chamber III’s third status conference on Wednesday, Sept. 16. “Masaya ako na nagkaroon ng status conference at finally nakita ng mga judges kung ano yung estado ni PRD ([former] president Rodrigo Duterte),” said Sara in a chance interview in South […]...
